sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 13:129

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 13:129:1
items.html: In one aspect, the hairs are greater and superior to the Chivaret, and in another aspect it is the reverse: As said above, the hairs of Arich Anpin bestow upon the Rosh [head] of Zeir Anpin, and bring forth in him the discernment of the tefillin of the head. But the Chivaret shine only for his NHY, who are the righteous. However, from another aspect, the Chivaret are superior to the hairs, for what is drawn from the Chivaret is found to clothe somewhat also in the internality of the vessels, but what is drawn from the hairs shines only in the aspect of surrounding lights, as above in the adjacent item. And what comes in the aspect of clothing is more important than what comes in the aspect of surrounding lights, which shines in the aspect of illumination from a distance.
